title: N-ary Tree Preorder Traversal
goal: Visit an N-ary tree in root-first order while preserving left-to-right child order.
strategy: A stack supplies the next node. Output the node immediately, then push its children in reverse order so the leftmost child becomes the next stack top.

edgeCases: An empty tree has no traversal values
Repeated values retain distinct node identities
A single long child chain exposes reversed traversal order
